hero.title: From Planning Engineer to Digital Architect
hero.subtitle: I don't just organize tasks. I engineer workflows that function like well-oiled machines.

chapters.title: I Was Always Building Something
content: Before I became a project planning engineer,
before I became a Notion Certified Admin,
I was just a kid obsessed with computers.
I was one of the first kids in my village to own a computer.
My uncle had an electronics shop — and I had unlimited curiosity.
I installed everything. Explored every setting. Changed Windows icons.
Broke the system more times than I can count.
Not because I had to. But because I wanted to understand how things worked.

chapters.title: Curiosity Turned Into Skill
content: I wasn’t just playing games.
I was learning: Microsoft Office, Graphic design, 3D tools, Marketing, Branding, Copywriting.
If I saw a new field, I studied it.
Not for certificates.
But because I genuinely love learning.

chapters.title: Engineering Shaped My Thinking
content: Later, I studied Civil Engineering.
That’s where everything connected.
Planning. Cost management. Project control. Systems thinking.
Engineering didn’t just teach me calculations.
It taught me structure.
And I realized something important: I don’t just like tools. I like systems.

chapters.title: The Notion Moment (2020)
content: In my first year of university, I discovered Notion.
At the time, I was testing every productivity app out there: TickTick, Microsoft To Do, and many others.
But they all had limits.
Notion was different.
It wasn’t a tool. It was a blank system waiting to be designed.
I struggled at first. Stopped. Came back. Learned again.
And then I stopped using Notion like a user… and started building with it.

chapters.title: From Creator to System Architect
content: By 2024, when Notion launched its marketplace, I was among the early creators.
I started my YouTube channel. Built a small studio. Bought a camera. Started teaching.
When Notion Academy opened, I earned certifications up to Notion Certified Admin.
But what truly mattered wasn’t certificates.
It was impact.

chapters.title: Building Communities
content: I founded:
- Arab Notion – to grow the Arabic Notion community
- Notion Muslims – to connect Muslims using Notion worldwide
Because I don’t just build systems.
I build ecosystems.

chapters.title: Today
content: Today, I help individuals, teams, and companies build structured Notion systems tailored to how they think and work.
Not templates.
Not random dashboards.
Systems.
Built for clarity.
Built for scale.
Built around you.
